reply.text:
I'm glad you said it, and I'm not going to skip past it. Thinking that everyone would be better off without you is serious, and it matters more than today's workout.

Please talk to someone right now. If you're in the US, you can call or text 988, the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, any hour. If you're elsewhere, your local emergency number or a crisis line can help. If you might act on these thoughts, call emergency services now. If you can, tell someone near you how you're feeling tonight, a friend, family member, or your doctor.

I'm a coach, so this one is beyond what I can help with, but I'm here and glad you told me. When you've talked to someone, the training will still be here, and we can take it as slow as you need.

Are you safe right now?
